method: Canonical builders re-read and hash every independent input. Source builder receives an external ID-only selection containing every current named ID plus every baseline source term, preserving authority coverage of withheld earlier candidates. Labels are extracted only from original source bodies. Ontology build passed before source-selection retry; its output is reused unchanged. All baseline ontology IDs were explicit include IDs. Existing terms and source metadata must remain byte-equivalent as JSON values before replacement.
